title: EU VAT Compliance: Rules, Registration & OSS Guide
summary: Understand EU VAT compliance: who must register, how OSS and IOSS work, invoicing rules, and how to prepare for ViDA changes.
body_markdown:
Your situation


Register in each country?


What to do


**You sell B2B to customers with validated VAT numbers**


Generally no


The[reverse charge mechanism](https://www.getsphere.com/blog/reverse-charge-vat) generally shifts the VAT liability to your customer


**You sell B2C, and your cross-border EU sales are under €10,000 a year**


No


Charge your home country's VAT rate


**You sell B2C, and your cross-border EU sales are over €10,000 a year**


No


Register once for OSS, or use IOSS for imported goods valued at €150 or less


**You hold stock, do property or installation work, or use a margin scheme in a specific country**


Yes


Get a local VAT registration in that country, regardless of OSS
